listingTitle: Peel and Stick Wallpaper Beige Neutral Vintage Forest Animals Floral Wallpaper Removable Self-Adhesive Contact Paper for Bedroom Living Room Cabinets Decoration Thicken Vinyl 17.3''x787''
listingLines: PEEL AND STICK WALLPAPER DESIGN--Beige natural forest animal wallpaper. Exquisite and rich elements of animals, trees, and flowers showcase a natural charm. Wallpaper made of environmentally friendly materials.
CONTACT PAPER SIZE--17.3" x 787"/Roll（In other words,1.44' x 66'/Roll ), it covers 94 sq.ft per roll.

FUNCTION--Faux vinyl/pvc material. Self adhesive, easy to apply, no need to use extra glue. Waterproof (but not for bathroom use). Indoor use, ideal for most smooth flat surfaces such as walls, furniture,etc.

EASY TO USE--There are scale lines on the back for measurement, cutting, and pasting. Self adhesive, ready to use. Removable without damaging the wall. The pattern can be perfectly spliced without gaps. DIY is available! This peel and stick wallpaper can be used for walls, cabinets, drawers, countertops, bookshelves, closet shelves, and more.
HOW MANY ROLLS TO BUY--We will calculate for you and recommend you the most economical purchase plan such as what size to buy and how many rolls to buy. Just inquire by asking a question.
summary: This self-adhesive wallpaper features a beige vintage forest animal and floral design for decorating indoor surfaces. It provides a removable solution for updating walls and furniture without the need for extra glue.
highlights: Features scale lines on the backing for measurement and cutting
Pattern is designed to splice together without gaps
Made from environmentally friendly faux vinyl and PVC materials
Waterproof for indoor use on smooth, flat surfaces

beforeYouBuy: Measure your surface area to determine how many 17.3 inch by 787 inch rolls you need to cover 94 square feet each.
